items.headline: GPT-5.5 Pro-assisted counterexample to Borsuk's conjecture in dimension 63
items.summary: Max Grinsztajn posted a 321-point set in 63 dimensions that cannot be split into 64 parts of smaller diameter, lowering the smallest known dimension where Borsuk's conjecture fails from 64. The README says the construction and proof were obtained with help from GPT-5.5 Pro, and the repository includes computer-verification scripts and certificates. Terence Tao's optimization-constants page lists 63 as the new bound. There is no peer-reviewed paper. A later arXiv preprint presenting the same construction as generated by GPT-5.6 Sol was withdrawn.
